buildingSMART Certification-datasets.about: Files buildingSMART uses for IFC import certification: one SketchUp scene (house, road, railway, two bridges) exported to IFC2x3, IFC4 and IFC4.3, plus small ISO Reference View examples.
buildingSMART Certification-datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0; a subset is in fixtures/ifc/buildingsmart

buildingSMART IFC4.x-specification-model.about: Small hand-written files that illustrate one IFC concept each (geometry types, placements, alignment, building elements, reinforcement). All in IFC4.3 ADD2. Good for geometry and parser edge cases, not for quantities.
buildingSMART IFC4.x-specification-model.licence: all rights reserved until formal release (final IFC: CC BY-ND 4.0); not copied into this repository

DURAARK (TIB), listed by BIMData.about: Real project models collected by the EU DURAARK project and hosted by TIB Hannover, reached through the BIMData list. Mostly 2005-2015 exports, IFC2x2 and IFC2x3, several disciplines per project.
DURAARK (TIB), listed by BIMData.licence: not stated on the download; not copied into this repository

OpenIFC Model Repository (Univ. of Auckl.about: User-contributed models, 172 files from IFC2.0 to IFC4 and many tools. The old _models/ links on the BIMData page are dead; files are now served from /api/download/<modelFile> (listing: /api/get-ifc-models). Only files up to 61 MB were downloaded and run.
OpenIFC Model Repository (Univ. of Auckl.licence: not stated per file; not copied into this repository

Schependomlaan (openBIMstandards, archiv.about: A real Dutch housing project: the architect's Archicad model, weekly 4D models from Synchro, and about 30 subcontractor models (Tekla steel and precast, HiCAD railings, Xella masonry, Revit floors, SketchUp utilities). The original repository is empty; the data is in Archive-DataSetSchependomlaan (Git LFS for one file). Files up to 35 MB were run.
Schependomlaan (openBIMstandards, archiv.licence: not stated (repository licence NOASSERTION); not copied into this repository

BIMData list: source unavailable.about: Entries on the BIMData page whose download no longer works.

uncovered: **IFC4.3 from real authoring tools.** Only the SketchUp certification scene and hand-written specification examples. No Civil 3D, OpenRoads / OpenBridge, Tekla, Allplan Bridge or other infrastructure exports.
**IFC4 from most tools.** Tested IFC4 comes from Revit (2015, 2019, 2021), Archicad (20, 23), Renga and SketchUp only. Tekla, Allplan, Vectorworks, MagiCAD and DDS-CAD appear in IFC2x3 only.
**Native-IFC and open-source tools.** No Bonsai (BlenderBIM), FreeCAD or BricsCAD files.
**Recent versions.** Nothing from Revit 2022+, Archicad 24+, Tekla 2022+, Vectorworks 2019+, Allplan after 2008 or MagiCAD after 2015.

**Large models.** 30 files over 60 MB (up to 288 MB) were not run; time and memory at that size are unknown. The largest file run is 60 MB, the most elements 11 451. The overlap check was off for the whole corpus.

**Quantities.** None of these files has a professional BoQ; only the Duplex and the buildingSMART samples have checked numbers (09). Reinforcement, MEP and infrastructure quantities are run, not verified.

**Federation.** Built, and run on two real architecture + structure pairs from Revit 2011 (NBU Office Building, NBU Medical Clinic): ownership, rooms on the other model's walls, columns and beams through the other model's walls and slabs, contradictions. Checked by inspection, not against a BoQ. Not federated yet: MEP models (the clinic's MEP file is 207 MB), the Schependomlaan subcontractor models, LTU A-House; no set from a tool other than Revit, and none whose models use different coordinate systems (shared coordinates are assumed).
**Old schemas.** 47 files are IFC2x2, IFC2x or IFC2.0, which ifcopenshell cannot read. Out of scope unless a client sends one.
**Other formats.** No ifcXML or IFC-JSON samples.
findings: **Crash on IfcGridPlacement** (specification model grid-placement): the placement helper assumed a relative placement. Fixed; placement is optional.
**IfcSignal counted twice**: in IFC4.3 it is a flow terminal, so both `mep-items` and `other-components` took it. Fixed in as-modelled.
**Invalid output for unnamed elements**: derived-line traces carried `name: null`, which the BoqResult contract forbids (Tekla and test files). Fixed and tested.

**Nested aggregates**: HiCAD railings nest bolts in fixings in railings; grandchildren of a measured element became 400 false `unmatched` questions, and parts below an unmeasured sub-assembly could be counted twice. Coverage and part-skipping now walk all ancestors; roll-up counts rolled-up sub-assemblies. Tested.

**Names**: steel grades used as material names (S355JR, A992, Q345B), CamelCase (ReinforcingSteel), EPDM, plurals, cast-in-place, psi concrete (C4000) and a few Norwegian layer words now resolve. Most remaining `needs input` results are local-language material names (Dutch, Norwegian, German); a general multi-language approach is on the roadmap (11) rather than adding languages one by one.

**Preset gaps**: no rules for IfcPlate (833 unmatched: curtain-wall panels and steel plates), IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementPart, untyped IFC2x3 IfcFlowSegment (DDS-CAD), ramps and stand-alone stair flights. as-modelled now has `curtain-walls`, `plates`, steel plates in `steel-sections`, and the classes added to `pipes` and `stairs`.
**Classes**: IFC4.3 IfcBuiltElement used as a generic object is handled like a proxy; IfcVirtualElement is no longer read as a physical element.
**Inputs**: `.ifczip` is accepted by the corpus runner, the API and the UI (Schependomlaan ships 27); IFC2x2 and older are skipped with a reason instead of a traceback.

**Data quality**: four COBie variants of the NBU Duplex and one Auckland sample are not valid STEP; Schependomlaan's `V_L_Constructief.ifc` is a Git LFS pointer unless fetched from the media host; the Lakeside file named RVT is Vectorworks and the one named VW is Revit; placeholder materials (`Default`, `Undefined/Undefined`, `Leer`, `Lege arcering`, `NO PRODUCT MATCHES CRITERIA`) block as unknown names; Tekla exported 447 empty `Steel Assembly` groups in one file (one grouped `unmatched` question).

**Run time**: up to 409 s for a 25 MB Vectorworks file and 308 s for an 11 MB file with 10 743 elements, without the overlap check. Fine for a dev build; a worker with progress reporting is needed for real projects.

**Steel-stud partitions given to structure** (NBU Office and Medical Clinic federated): the ownership preset gave walls with a steel main material to structure, and stud layers resolve to `metal.steel.stud`; 1,544 partitions marked `LoadBearing = false` became federation holes. Fixed in `presets/settings/federation.json`: an explicit non-load-bearing flag wins, studs are not structural steel.

**Curtain-wall mullions and stair stringers as holes** (NBU Medical Clinic): `IfcMember` parts of architectural aggregates were reported as structure's missing elements (534). Fixed: a part of an aggregate its own model owns is taken with it, without a warning.

**False thickness contradiction on wall stubs** (NBU Medical Clinic): a partition shorter than it is thick has its oriented box's thin axis along its length (+439%). Fixed: thickness contradictions only for clear plates (thin axis at most half the width, both sides alike).
